findings.issue: The summary marks iteration 10 as the cap, yet production code was changed and published in iteration 13 and the workflow has now run a seventeenth implementer tick. The current bookkeeping-only tick cannot undo that violation.
findings.consequence: Another implementation tick in this workflow would violate the governing stop condition.
findings.correction: Stop this loop after this review, preserve the published linear history without reset/revert/force operations, and carry product findings into a separately authorized run.

findings.criterion: 7 and cross-cutting security — mandatory idempotency for Super Admin tenant creation
findings.issue: POST /v1/platform/tenants is replaySafe rather than idempotent, so definePlatformRoute executes it without an Idempotency-Key. Current successful tests exercise that keyless path; retrying a lost keyless response reruns no-slug provisioning and can create a random-suffixed second tenant.
findings.consequence: One intended Super Admin action can create duplicate properties, owners, inventory, policy, and audit history.
findings.correction: Require Idempotency-Key on tenant creation, update callers/tests, assert keyless rejection and exact-key replay of one property, and cover lost-response retry plus in-flight submission in the rendered Platform form.

findings.criterion: 7 and cross-cutting data integrity — atomic, recoverable platform creation/idempotency
findings.issue: The reservation, create_tenant call, tenant initialization, business result, and replay finalization span separate autocommits/transactions with no lease, reconciliation, compensation, or durable operation identity. A failure after creation or business commit can leave an incomplete property and/or status=0 permanently; exact retry is blocked while a fresh key can duplicate it.
findings.consequence: A created property can be stranded or partially initialized and recovery can create a random-suffixed duplicate.
findings.correction: Atomically bind creation/initialization and idempotency completion, or persist a unique operation identity that can reconstruct or safely complete the one property; fault-inject post-create and post-business-commit/pre-finalization failures.

findings.criterion: 6 and 7 — recoverable local-auth person and owner onboarding
findings.issue: Local creation stores only the generated password hash, while replay storage replaces temporaryPassword with null. A lost first response replays 201 without the sole credential; the UI reports an invitation that local auth did not create, and local auth exposes no recovery path.
findings.consequence: A created member or a new property's only owner can be unable to sign in.
findings.correction: Provide a recoverable setup/invitation or authenticated credential-reset flow with an explicit replay outcome while keeping secrets out of replay storage; test lost-response retries through first local sign-in.

findings.issue: The rendered join starts from a fabricated token, mounts GuestPass directly, replaces the scanner, and mocks lookup/redeem. Separate API tests cover expiry and tamper rejection, but no recorded execution joins server-generated bytes to real Share, public /pass bootstrap, decoded guest QR, and real gate validation.
findings.consequence: The exact artifact produced by the live flow has not been shown to survive sharing and redeem as the same valid pass.
findings.correction: In a future authorized run, execute a routed mobile-browser story from live issue through Share, /pass fragment bootstrap, QR decode, and real lookup/redeem, asserting exact token identity, two-hour expiry, HMAC rejection, and stored verify_code mismatch rejection.

findings.criterion: 3 and 4 — real camera plate scanning at check-in and check-out
findings.issue: Rendered tests replace LiveCamera with a button emitting an already-decoded plate. No recorded run executes getUserMedia, the shipped ONNX loader/decoder, a camera fixture, and responsive browser rendering; existing camera E2E covers check-in only.
findings.consequence: Actual camera acquisition and model decoding remain unverified in the shipped stack for both required flows.
findings.correction: In a future authorized run, record 390x844 real-model fake-camera check-in and checkout stories, including filled fields, match/result, model/browser/fixture versions, stopped tracks, and clean console.

findings.criterion: 6 and 7 — complete real-stack CRUD and cross-property operations
findings.issue: Rendered tests mock every API and complete a full lifecycle only for a unit; person is create-only, site/zone/slot lifecycles are incomplete, cross-property coverage is one mocked member POST, and jsdom innerWidth does not exercise CSS layout. No real-stack narrow-browser run is recorded.
findings.consequence: Persisted all-entity administration, complete cross-property Super Admin behavior, server authorization boundaries, and narrow-screen usability remain unverified in context.
findings.correction: In a future authorized run, execute full person/site/unit/slot lifecycles through the real routed UI/API at a narrow viewport, perform representative all-entity operations in a second property as Super Admin, and prove regular-admin server denial.
